title: A Spider Weaves Webs 82 Feet Wide Across Rivers

scenes.text: One spider hangs its web across a whole river.
Darwin's bark spider lives in Madagascar.
Its anchor threads stretch up to 82 feet over the water.
Its silk is more than twice as tough as any spider silk measured before.
Scientists reported it up to ten times tougher than Kevlar.
All that strength, just to catch mayflies.

description:
